title: switch_ring
description: Switches the places of two rings, among the contested ring, the unclaimed ring pool and the claimed ring pools, e.g. to resolve an effect (Elemental Fury, Know the World). A ring that becomes the contested ring keeps the type of the conflict, and the attacking player takes the fate on it; a ring that goes to a claimed ring pool takes the conflict type of the ring it replaces. During a conflict, the contested ring is only switched with a ring of the unclaimed or claimed ring pool of the attacking player. The fate on the other rings stays on them.

other_ring.description: Ring it is switched with, from another place.
